# QR encoder

- qrcode-generator 2.0.4, by Kazuhiko Arase (MIT).
- Original, unmodified browser distribution: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/blob/js2.0.4/js/dist/qrcode.js
- License: `qrcode-generator-LICENSE.txt` (also preserved in the source header).
- Served from `/vendor/qrcode-generator-2.0.4.js` only after the teacher clicks `QR 크게 보기`.
- No external QR API or CDN is used. QR error correction: M; quiet zone: four modules.
